scope: fixed standardized-margin blend DEVELOPMENT screening; not independent holdout

independent_review.method: Reconstruct from parent raw caches, row-normalize and blend independently; compare matrices, predictions, aggregate metrics and paired prompt bootstrap

limitations: All scores come from previously inspected development OOF; no independent holdout or nested validation.
95% prompt intervals are conditional and unadjusted; sparse repeats reuse models/prompts.
One missing-class bootstrap draw in m2-repeat0 makes its interval null for each candidate.
The primary point screen is not a non-inferiority test or automatic promotion decision.
